summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K on 22 June 2026 announcing that the Board agreed a contract extending Group CEO Michael O'Leary's tenure until April 2032. The contract includes a modest salary, capped bonus, and a one-off option over 10 million ordinary shares at a strike price of €26.70/$65.00, vesting upon achieving demanding PAT (>€4bn) or share price (>€42/$102 for 28 days) targets by 2032. The Board consulted major shareholders. An amended remuneration policy will be subject to an advisory vote at the 2026 AGM. This is a routine CEO contract extension, not a forced departure; however, the filing constitutes a material management/compensation event.
